patterns.note: The brand name is used as a monumental, repeated, and partially overlapping visual element across the hero section, creating a strong, almost sculptural brand identity.
Extreme contrast in type scale, featuring a very large, decorative serif font for the brand name and small, understated sans-serif for navigation and detailed information.
A warm, earthy terracotta background dominates the main content area, providing a rich backdrop for stark black typography and contrasting with a light, neutral beige footer.

As the user scrolls, the main content area, including the large brand name and central image, scrolls upwards and off-screen, revealing a distinct footer section that appears from the bottom of the viewport.

technique_notes: The hero section is constructed by layering multiple instances of the brand name, rendered in a massive serif typeface, with a central image positioned on top, creating a dynamic, stacked visual effect that scrolls with the page content.
The page employs a straightforward vertical scroll, where the primary content area moves upwards to expose a separate, full-width footer section that slides into view from the bottom.

design_tokens.type_scale: Monumental display serif (~8x body) for the brand name, contrasted with small, understated sans-serif for navigation and footer details.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical spacing around the central image and large text elements, transitioning to a more balanced density in the footer.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost sculptural use of the brand name itself as the primary visual element in the hero, repeated and layered with a central image. This creates an immediate, strong brand statement that is highly memorable and deviates significantly from typical hero sections.
